### Scope

#### In-Scope

List the functionalities, features, or aspects that are included in the project

#### Out-of-Scope

List functionalities, features, or aspects that are explicitly *excluded* from the project

### Requirements

Provide a detailed breakdown of what the feature should do, some typical features are:

- Capabilities
- Workflow processes
- Scalability
- Run time
- Usability
- Reusability

Example:

- The tool must import data and return visualizations and statistics
- The user will upload a configuration and data
- The tool will process that data
- The tool will return the desired values
- The tool will allow multiple configurations (BPA/WPU)
